name: Ore no Nee-chan to Tenkousei ga Erokunatta Wake
original_name: 俺のねーちゃんと転校生がエロくなった理由
source:
True love and school life simulation with an immoral dilemma.
Freely enjoy the time between Golden Week holiday and Summer Vacation.

Daily life was peaceful but busy:
You were deeply involved in school, and were dating a transfer student.
Then you had that sweet, dangerous night with your sister.

The secret thrill led to another incident. And another.
Each day the perversion escalated a bit more.

Two heroines, two lives and developments.
Forbidden incest and a dream school life.
Which will you choose?

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE087112.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
一款围绕违背伦理的两难选择展开的真爱与校园生活模拟游戏。
你可以自由享受从黄金周假期到暑假之间的时光。

日常生活平静却又忙碌：
你积极投身校园活动，还与一名转学生交往。
可随后，你却与姐姐度过了那个甜蜜而危险的夜晚。

秘密带来的刺激又引发了另一起意外。然后是下一起。
变态的欲望一天比一天更加失控。

两位女主角，两种人生，两条发展轨迹。
禁忌的乱伦，与梦寐以求的校园生活。
你会选择哪一边？
